narrative_profile: Prefers a bohemian core translated into polished, smart-casual pieces: fitted silhouettes with intentional tailoring rather than slouchy shapes. Prefers a pastel-soft and muted-neutral palette—dusty rose, sage green, oatmeal, soft taupe and dove gray—and avoids stark monochrome blacks or high-contrast colorblocking. Prefers natural fibers such as linen, cotton, silk and lightweight wool that hold structure and show subtle texture rather than synthetics or heavy stretch. Prefers plain, low-detail construction with minimal hardware or embellishment, while accepting surface interest through patterns: chooses either small ditsy florals or larger organic paisley and ikat prints over embroidery, sequins, or ruffles. Prefers smart-casual pieces that read collected and refined—fitted linen-blend blouses, tapered cotton trousers, silk slip skirts in dusty neutrals—so when shown options this user will pick a tailored sage-linen blouse with a small floral print over an oversized monochrome black tunic or a heavily embellished boho dress.

Prefers a smart-casual aesthetic anchored in high-saturation monochrome palettes such as navy blue, jet black, charcoal gray, cobalt, emerald, and crimson, and avoids pastel or soft colorways. Prefers oversized silhouettes—oversized blazers, boxy coats, longline trousers, and roomy shirt-dresses—and explicitly avoids relaxed, slouchy cuts that read informal. Prefers garments made from natural fibers like cotton, wool, and linen as well as technical synthetics such as performance polyester and nylon, and avoids leather and suede. Prefers plain pieces or garments with subtle detailing—minimal seams, concealed buttons, tone-on-tone topstitching—and avoids heavy decoration or conspicuous embellishment. Prefers large-scale patterns such as wide pinstripes, oversized plaids, and broad houndstooth rather than small graphic prints, and prefers a formal leaning within smart-casual: structured, statement-focused items over semi-formal or casually proportioned alternatives.

Prefers a modern bohemian aesthetic anchored in soft pastels and muted neutrals, specifically dusty rose, sage green, dove gray, oatmeal, and warm taupe. Prefers fitted silhouettes—nipped waists, tapered trousers, slim-wrap dresses and cropped blazers—that maintain a tailored, smart-casual line rather than oversized or boxy shapes. Prefers natural fibers such as linen, slub cotton, washed silk and lightweight merino wool for their texture and breathability, and avoids synthetic high-shine fabrics. Prefers subtle detailing: pintucks, small scalloped hems, tone-on-tone embroidery, mother-of-pearl buttons and minimal lace trim instead of heavy embellishment; prefers garments that read refined rather than ornate. Likes both small-scale ditsy florals and carefully composed large-scale botanical or ikat prints, and avoids strict monochrome looks, favoring layered color combinations and low-contrast tonal mixing that read intentional and composed.

Prefers a minimalist wardrobe built from muted neutrals and deep-dark monochrome tones — charcoal gray, navy blue, black, warm beige and olive — and avoids high-saturation hues like neon or bright primary colors. Prefers fitted and structured silhouettes such as tailored slim-leg jeans, cropped structured blazers, and slim-fit button-downs, and avoids oversized, boxy, or slouchy shapes. Prefers denim as a core material (rigid or minimally washed indigo denim for jeans and jackets) alongside clean-weight cotton and fine-knit merino, and avoids heavy embellishments, sequins, or excessive hardware. Prefers plain solid surfaces with no large patterns or graphic prints, and avoids florals, bold stripes, and statement logos. Prefers casual formality expressed through minimal accessories — matte black leather belts, simple silver or gold studs, and unbranded low-profile sneakers or Chelsea boots — and avoids ornate jewelry, flashy hardware, or decorative trims.

Prefers smart-casual pieces in a palette of muted neutrals and high-saturation accents such as charcoal gray, taupe, olive green, mustard yellow, cobalt blue, and brick red; avoids pastel tones like baby pink, powder blue, and mint. Prefers structured, fitted silhouettes with defined shoulders, tapered waists, and slim trousers or pencil skirts; avoids relaxed, slouchy, or oversized cuts. Prefers knit fabrics—merino, ribbed cotton, and lightweight cashmere blends—for tops and layered pieces; avoids leather and suede. Prefers heavy decorative detail such as embroidered patches, appliqué, chunky beading, braided trims, contrast piping, and statement buttons; avoids subtle or minimal detailing. Prefers small-scale patterns or solid surfaces—micro-checks, pin-sized florals, tiny stripes, and solids—and avoids large-scale prints, oversized graphics, and bold all-over patterns. Prefers casual to very casual formality with a considered, tailored look and avoids formal suiting and overtly dressy constructions.
